Such a design can obtain the most beneficial migration, which achieves low migration cost and an appropriate number of partitions. We conduct comprehensive experiments using large-scale datasets from real-world applications to evaluate this design. The results show that Nereus improves the throughput by 51% and reduces the processing latency by 99%, compared to existing designs.

articleTitle: Hybrid Write Strategy Based on Hot Data Recognition and Channel Busyness Perception for Consumer Solid-State Drives
abstract: The NAND flash-based solid-state drive (SSD) has been widely used in consumer electronic products such as digital cameras, smartphones and laptops. In these products, the life and performance of SSDs are related to the write strategy of SSDs. In this paper, we propose a Hot data and channel Busyness Perception based Hybrid Write strategy, briefly as HBPHW. The key idea of HBPHW is to use the tradeoff between flash programming speed and data retention time to optimize the performance of SSDs, while not significantly deteriorating their life. Firstly, we use data heat and channel busyness to model the fast write decision index, and then compare it with the fast write threshold to decide whether to carry on fast write. Secondly, we add two items in the address mapping table, namely, the fast write flag and the rewrite deadline, to manage the fast write data. At last, we propose a mechanism to adaptively adjust the fast write threshold to maximize the fast write benefit. Experimental results on three consumer workloads verify the effectiveness of HBPHW, which can greatly improve the performance of SSD at the cost of the acceptable rewrite overhead.

articleTitle: Guest Editorial Complex Network Analysis and Applications in Next-Generation Consumer Electronics
abstract: Consumer Electronics (CE) has experienced remarkable advancement in transformative technologies, to name a few, Internet-of-Things (IoT), Artificial Intelligence (AI), Machine Learning (ML), cloud computing, etc.

articleTitle: Guest Editorial DENSE - Data Integrity, Integration and Security Issues for Consumer Data in Industry 5.0
abstract: Future personalization services are key to Industry 5.0. Also known as the fifth industrial revolution, it leverages artificial intelligence and cognitive services for cooperation between machines and humans. This collaboration aims to increase consumer value while improving industrial automation. Industry 5.0 focuses more on cooperation than competition. Personalized services are provided by linking data from various sensors to highlight distinct product characteristics based on consumer preferences. A high-tech strategy uses the Internet of Things to provide industrial automation along with personalized consumer services through symmetric innovation via democratized Big Data knowledge.

articleTitle: Guest Editorial Network Automation for Consumer Internet of Things in Smart Healthcare
abstract: Upgrading of healthcare systems has never been so urgent in recent years, after the witness of limited resource availability and efficiency during the global pandemic of COVID-19. Although Healthcare 4.0 has been raised for years, we are still in the transition from Healthcare 3.0 to it, pursuing smart and efficient healthcare services with low cost. With the popularity of consumer electronics in the last decades, consumer Internet of Things (IoT) has been widely adopted in healthcare systems to speed up the evolution process, which will continue proliferated in the future, directly supporting remote healthcare services and automated operations.

articleTitle: Guest Editorial of the Special Section on Consumer Electronics With Artificial Intelligence
abstract: Artificial Intelligence (AI), Machine Learning (ML), and Deep Learning (DL) represent game changer technologies for Consumer Electronics (CE). In fact, they ever more represent the core of most CE products, and they are also changing the way these products are designed and engineered.
